entities:
- id: ENT-HB-ID-001
  entity_type: identity
  label: Microbiome-friendly whole-body care intention
  description: The public storefront frames Biotic around microbiome-friendly deodorant
    and full-spectrum care.
  assertion: The public storefront presents Biotic through microbiome-friendly deodorant
    and broader whole-body care language.
  interpretation: This supports a proposed whole-body-care identity direction; it does
    not establish an approved internal positioning or a complete product portfolio.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use as a source-attributed identity hypothesis in briefs and concept exploration.
  constraints:
  - Preserve its proposed status and attribute the underlying framing to Biotic's public storefront.
  - Do not present whole-body care as an approved internal strategy without further evidence.
  unknowns:
  - Internal positioning, portfolio intent, and approval status are not available in the public corpus.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-001
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
  epistemic_status: reported
- id: ENT-HB-EX-001
  entity_type: expression
  label: Playful body-positive verbal expression
  description: Public copy uses informal body language such as pit-care and Hello
    everyBODY.
  assertion: Biotic's public copy uses informal body-positive phrases including pit-care
    and Hello everyBODY.
  interpretation: The observed language makes product education feel approachable and
    body-positive rather than clinical.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use as an observed expression pattern when drafting or reviewing public-facing copy.
  constraints:
  - Preserve the distinction between an observed pattern and an approved internal voice rule.
  unknowns:
  - No internal copy standard or approval matrix is available.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-001
  epistemic_status: observed
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
- id: ENT-HB-OF-001
  entity_type: offering
  label: Brightening Probiotic Deodorant
  description: A publicly listed deodorant with documented formats and subscription
    options.
  assertion: Biotic publicly lists Brightening Probiotic Deodorant with documented formats
    and subscription options.
  interpretation: This is an observed offering record, not evidence of availability in every market.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use for product-specific briefs after verifying the current product page, SKU, and market.
  constraints:
  - Do not generalize current formats, availability, ingredients, or claims across markets or time.
  unknowns:
  - Current inventory, market availability, formula, and subscription terms require live verification.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-002
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
  epistemic_status: reported
- id: ENT-HB-XP-001
  entity_type: experience
  label: Direct product education and purchase journey
  description: The storefront and product pages combine education, ingredients, purchase
    choices, and FAQ guidance.
  assertion: Biotic's storefront and product pages combine product education, ingredient
    explanation, purchase choices, and FAQ guidance.
  interpretation: The observed journey uses education to bridge product consideration and purchase.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use as a public-journey observation when designing briefs, content sequences, or reviews.
  constraints:
  - Do not infer conversion performance or customer comprehension from the presence of content.
  unknowns:
  - Journey analytics, usability evidence, and internal experience principles are unavailable.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-001
  - EVID-HB-002
  - EVID-HB-004
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
  epistemic_status: reported
- id: ENT-HB-PE-001
  entity_type: perception
  label: Public testimonial layer
  description: The storefront displays customer testimonials; these are reported site
    content, not representative outcome research.
  assertion: Biotic's storefront displays customer testimonial statements.
  interpretation: The testimonials expose public customer language but do not establish
    representative perception or product outcomes.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use as attributed testimonial language or as a prompt for further research.
  constraints:
  - Do not treat testimonials as representative customer evidence or independent efficacy proof.
  unknowns:
  - Sampling, moderation, verification, and representativeness are not documented.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-001
  epistemic_status: observed
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
- id: ENT-HB-GV-001
  entity_type: governance
  label: Founder-reported brand stewardship
  description: The public story identifies Sadaf and Leila as founders; it does not
    expose approval or governance procedures.
  assertion: Biotic's public story identifies Sadaf and Leila as founders.
  interpretation: This supports founder stewardship as a public governance signal, but
    does not reveal operational authority or approval procedures.
  permitted_uses:
  - Attribute the founder relationship to the public story when relevant.
  constraints:
  - Do not infer decision rights, legal roles, or approval authority.
  unknowns:
  - Current roles, decision rights, approval workflows, and governance procedures are unavailable.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-003
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported
  epistemic_status: reported
- id: ENT-HB-EN-001
  entity_type: environment
  label: People evaluating natural deodorant alternatives
  description: A bounded public audience environment inferred from product and FAQ
    framing, not a validated ICP.
  assertion: Product and FAQ content addresses people evaluating alternatives to standard antiperspirants.
  interpretation: This suggests a bounded consideration environment; it is not a validated
    customer segment or ideal-customer profile.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use as a research hypothesis for audience framing and information needs.
  constraints:
  - Do not state segment size, purchase behavior, demographic composition, or validated fit.
  unknowns:
  - Internal segmentation, independent audience research, and behavioral data are unavailable.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-002
  - EVID-HB-004
  perspective: inferred
  epistemic_status: inferred
  limitations:
  - No internal segmentation or independent audience study is available.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
- id: ENT-HB-EV-001
  entity_type: event
  label: Public product ecosystem snapshot
  description: The verified storefront publicly lists deodorant and Daily Sunshine
    powder products at the research cutoff.
  assertion: At the research cutoff, Biotic's verified storefront listed deodorant and
    Daily Sunshine powder products.
  interpretation: This is a time-bounded public portfolio snapshot, not a permanent offering definition.
  permitted_uses:
  - Use for time-bounded portfolio context with the research cutoff stated.
  constraints:
  - Refresh the live storefront before making current portfolio or availability statements.
  unknowns:
  - Products added, removed, renamed, or made unavailable after the cutoff are not represented.
  evidence_ids:
  - EVID-HB-001
  - EVID-HB-005
  epistemic_status: observed
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
  status: proposed
  perspective: reported

notes:
- id: EVID-HB-001
  source_id: SRC-HB-001
  evidence_excerpt: Meet your microbiome-friendly deodorant.
  paraphrased_findings:
  - The storefront frames the core product around microbiome-friendly deodorant and
    whole-body care.
  - The site presents no-aluminum, no-baking-soda, no-parabens, cruelty-free, and
    unisex attributes as its own claims.
  actor_authority: hellobiotic_self_description
  perspective: intended
  epistemic_status: reported
  limitations:
  - Brand-authored public claims do not independently establish health, safety, efficacy,
    or customer outcomes.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
- id: EVID-HB-002
  source_id: SRC-HB-002
  evidence_excerpt: Instead of masking odor, it supports your underarm microbiome
    to neutralize stink-causing bacteria at the source.
  paraphrased_findings:
  - The product page describes a 99% natural, aluminum-free, baking-soda-free deodorant
    with prebiotic and probiotic ingredients.
  - The page offers 2 oz, 0.6 oz, and duo formats plus subscription frequency options.
  actor_authority: hellobiotic_product_description
  perspective: intended
  epistemic_status: reported
  limitations:
  - Product-page language is not an independent clinical efficacy or regulatory assessment.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
- id: EVID-HB-003
  source_id: SRC-HB-003
  evidence_excerpt: Founded by two adventurous best friends.
  paraphrased_findings:
  - The founders Sadaf and Leila describe a six-year development process and a desire
    for a natural, effective deodorant.
  - The story says the brand aims to work for people across age, body type, and sex.
  actor_authority: founder_reported_story
  perspective: intended
  epistemic_status: reported
  limitations:
  - Founder story is a self-description and does not establish product outcomes for
    every person.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
- id: EVID-HB-004
  source_id: SRC-HB-004
  evidence_excerpt: It is not an antiperspirant.
  paraphrased_findings:
  - The FAQ distinguishes the deodorant from antiperspirants and says a transition
    period may occur when changing products.
  - The FAQ describes packaging choices and product claims from the brand perspective.
  actor_authority: hellobiotic_faq
  perspective: intended
  epistemic_status: reported
  limitations:
  - FAQ explanations and health-adjacent statements require qualified review before
    use as medical or safety advice.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
- id: EVID-HB-005
  source_id: SRC-HB-005
  evidence_excerpt: A pre+probiotic supplement formulated to support the essential
    gut microbiome.
  paraphrased_findings:
  - The site presents Daily Sunshine as a separate pre+probiotic powder product with
    digestion, mood, and stress-related support claims.
  - The page identifies non-GMO, gluten-free, and vegan claims.
  actor_authority: hellobiotic_product_description
  perspective: intended
  epistemic_status: reported
  limitations:
  - Supplement claims are brand-authored product statements and need regulatory and
    scientific review before health messaging or advice.
  context_ids:
  - CTX-HELLOBIOTIC-DEODORANT-CURRENT
